article.headline: Alabama State secures 60-59 victory over Florida A&M
article.description: — Amarr Knox scored 17 points and TJ Madlock's basket with 12 seconds left provided the winning points as Alabama State beat Florida A&M 60-59 on Saturday night.
article.linkText: Alabama State secures 60-59 victory over Florida A&M

categories.description: Florida A&M Rattlers @ Alabama State Hornets

event.description: Florida A&M Rattlers @ Alabama State Hornets

keywords: Florida A&M Rattlers @ Alabama State Hornets
article.story: MONTGOMERY, Ala. -- — Amarr Knox scored 17 points and TJ Madlock's basket with 12 seconds left provided the winning points as Alabama State beat Florida A&M 60-59 on Saturday night. Knox added six rebounds and four steals for the Hornets (13-14, 9-5 Southwestern Athletic Conference). CJ Hines scored nine points, shooting 3 for 16, including 1 for 7 from beyond the arc. Madlock had eight points and shot 1 of 5 from the field and 6 of 6 from the free-throw line. Sterling Young led the Rattlers (12-13, 9-5) in scoring, finishing with 23 points. Roderick Coffee III added 13 points, eight rebounds, four assists and three blocks for Florida A&M. Ja'Derryus Eatmon also recorded seven points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
